pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vosāsantiyo ṭhitā honti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.4: idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo vosāsantiyo na nivāressantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo vosāsantiyo na nivārethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhuniyo vosāsantiyo na nivāressatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.15.1: bhikkhū paneva kulesu nimantitā bhuñjanti. tatra ce bhikkhunī vosāsamānarūpā ṭhitā hoti idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethāti. tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā apasakka tāva bhagini yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantīti. ekassapi ce bhikkhuno nappaṭibhāseyya taṃ bhikkhuniṃ apasādetuṃ apasakka tāva bhagini yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantīti paṭidesetabbaṃ tehi bhikkhūhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:1.16: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjimhā asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ taṃ paṭidesemāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.2: kulaṃ nāma cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.4: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.8: yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamānupajjhāyakatā yathāsamānācariyakatā idha sūpaṃ detha idha odanaṃ dethāti ayaṃ vosāsantī nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.13: tehi bhikkhūhi sā bhikkhunī apasādetabbā apasakka tāva bhagini yāva bhikkhū bhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.1.14: ekassapi ce bhikkhuno anapasādite khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti paṭiggaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññī vosāsantiyā na nivāreti āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematiko vosāsantiyā na nivāreti āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññī vosāsantiyā na nivāreti āpatti pāṭidesanīyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd2:2.2.4: ekatoupasampannāya vosāsantiyā na nivāreti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
